Chinese launch-entry pressure suit derived from the Soviet Sokol family. Used on Shenzhou 5 (Yang Liwei, China's first crewed spaceflight, 2003) and every subsequent Shenzhou mission to date.
China's launch-entry suit, worn on every Shenzhou flight since 2003

Chinese launch-entry pressure suit derived from the Soviet Sokol family. Used on Shenzhou 5 in 2003 when Yang Liwei became China's first taikonaut, and on every subsequent Shenzhou mission. Back-entry seam, fixed helmet, umbilical-fed; the architectural similarity to Sokol reflects China's early space-program technology transfer from Russia.
